sub_answers.text: Blue Lock won the 45th Kodansha Manga Award in the shōnen category in 2021 [d66515250s0p0]. Gintama has received praise for its comedy and characters, has appeared in multiple polls and rankings (including 12th in TV Asahi’s Manga Sōsenkyo 2021) and was nominated in the Society for the Promotion of Japanese Animation Award of 2008 for Best Manga – Comedy [d8584387s19p0][d8584387s0p0]. Berserk has received e-book excellence awards from Hakusensha's Denshi Shoseki Taishō in 2015 and 2021 and achieved major sales milestones cited by publishers and distributors [d286738s15p0]. Delicious in Dungeon has won the 55th Seiun Award for Best Comic in 2024 and other manga awards including the Japan Society and Anime NYC American Manga Awards and the Harvey Award in Best Manga in 2024 [d48746266s6p0].

sub_answers.text: Blue Lock had over 50 million copies in circulation worldwide by September 2025, marking it among the best-selling manga series [d66515250s0p0]. One Piece had over 600 million copies in circulation worldwide by March 2026 and has extensive international licensing and merchandising, including English releases by Viz Media and a Netflix live-action adaptation [d360759s0p0]. Berserk reported substantial English-language sales (over 2 million in North America by September 2018 and over 10 million English copies by February 2026) and high rankings on U.S. sales charts [d286738s15p0]. Gintama was licensed by Viz Media in North America and showed strong English sales with volumes appearing in Diamond Comic Distributors' Top 300 Graphic Novels [d8584387s0p0][d8584387s19p0].

sub_answers.text: The manga has been serialized in Weekly Shōnen Jump since July 1997 [d360759s0p0]. An anime television series adaptation by Toei Animation premiered in October 1999 [d360759s0p0]. Production I.G produced a festival film adaptation and Toei Animation has developed 14 animated feature films and one original video animation (OVA) based on the series [d360759s0p0]. A U.S./UK/North America English-language release was licensed to Viz Media and distribution in Australia was licensed to Madman Entertainment (licensing dates not specified in the chunks) [d360759s0p0]. An American live-action television adaptation was announced in July 2017 with Eiichiro Oda as executive producer and Tomorrow Studios/Shueisha involvement, Netflix ordered a 10-episode first season in January 2020, and Netflix released a live-action TV series adaptation in 2023 with a second season confirmed in 2023 and a third season announced in August 2025 (production delays noted due to COVID-19 and the 2023 SAG-AFTRA strike) [d62976709s2p0][d360759s0p0].

sub_answers.text: Detective Conan (Case Closed) had extensive licensed merchandise sales in Japan totaling at least ¥29.21 billion between 2003 and 2012, broken down as ¥2.89 billion in 2003, ¥17.29 billion during 2005–2008, and ¥9.03 billion during 2010–2012 [d298049s11p0]. After Miura's death, Dark Horse's deluxe edition of Berserk saw the first eight volumes rank on Amazon's top 100 overall best-selling books list, showing a documented high-profile retail/visibility event tied to the series and its special editions [d286738s15p0]. One Piece volumes also show documented very large initial print runs (examples: 4.05 million for volume 67 and multiple volumes with initial prints above 3 million), evidencing print-scale promotional strategies affecting availability and sales [d360759s18p0].
